# toImageFitMode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`ImageFitModeInput`](image-fit-mode-input.md) to the [`ImageFitMode`](image-fit-mode.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toImageFitMode(input: ImageFitModeToken | ImageFitMode): ImageFitMode
```
